messages.content: You read a technician's description of a Voron 0.2 3D printer fault and list the parts that could cause it, most likely first, using the cards given. Reply with JSON only.

DESCRIPTION: Under-extrusion only at high speed, fine when slow
CARDS:
COMPONENT extruder_motor (Extruder motor and driver) - Turns the extruder gears to push a metered length of filament into the hotend.
Failure mode: wrong setting (direction, rotation_distance, current, stall threshold) | symptom: moves wrong way, wrong distance, skipped steps or bad homing | check: compare config values with stock and calibrate
Failure mode: insufficient torque or driver fault | symptom: skipping/clicking under load or at high acceleration | check: raise current within limits; check driver temperature and wiring
COMPONENT hotend_heater (Hotend heater cartridge) - Heats the hotend block so filament melts; controlled by PID from the hotend thermistor reading.
Failure mode: no or weak heating (open circuit, loose cartridge, failed output) | symptom: slow or no heat-up, 'not heating at expected rate' error, cold prints | check: watch temperature graph during heat-up; measure resistance; check cartridge clamped
Failure mode: control or limit setting wrong (PID, max_temp) | symptom: temperature oscillates or printer shuts down at high temperature | check: compare PID/max_temp with stock config; re-run PID_CALIBRATE
COMPONENT extruder_gears_guidler (Extruder gears and guidler (idler arm)) - Grips the filament between drive gears; guidler sets the grip tension.
Failure mode: loose, slipping or worn transmission | symptom: layer shifts, dimensional error, slipping or under-feeding | check: check tension/grub screws/wear; mark and observe slip
Failure mode: misalignment or binding | symptom: periodic artefacts, noise, uneven motion | check: move by hand with motors off; check alignment
COMPONENT xy_pulleys_idlers (XY pulleys and idlers) - Drive pulleys on motor shafts (grub screws) and idlers that route the belts.
Failure mode: loose, slipping or worn transmission | symptom: layer shifts, dimensional error, slipping or under-feeding | check: check tension/grub screws/wear; mark and observe slip
Failure mode: misalignment or binding | symptom: periodic artefacts, noise, uneven motion | check: move by hand with motors off; check alignment
COMPONENT toolhead (Toolhead body and mounts) - Holds hotend, extruder and fans rigidly on the X carriage.
Failure mode: not rigid, loose or not level | symptom: uneven first layer, ringing, height varies by position | check: check fasteners and tramming; press test
COMPONENT xy_belts (XY (A/B) belts) - Transmit motor motion to the toolhead in the CoreXY layout; need equal tension.
Failure mode: loose, slipping or worn transmission | symptom: layer shifts, dimensional error, slipping or under-feeding | check: check tension/grub screws/wear; mark and observe slip
Failure mode: misalignment or binding | symptom: periodic artefacts, noise, uneven motion | check: move by hand with motors off; check alignment
COMPONENT heatbreak_ptfe (Heatbreak and PTFE/bowden tube) - Guides filament from extruder into the hot zone and keeps the cold and hot zones separated.
Failure mode: partial or full blockage | symptom: thin, gappy lines; extruder clicks | check: cold pull; extrude in air and watch flow
Failure mode: gap or mismatch in filament path | symptom: leaks, stringing, intermittent jams | check: re-seat tube/nozzle; check fittings
COMPONENT bed_heater (Bed heater) - Heats the build plate so the first layer adheres.
Failure mode: no or weak heating (open circuit, loose cartridge, failed output) | symptom: slow or no heat-up, 'not heating at expected rate' error, cold prints | check: watch temperature graph during heat-up; measure resistance; check cartridge clamped
Failure mode: control or limit setting wrong (PID, max_temp) | symptom: temperature oscillates or printer shuts down at high temperature | check: compare PID/max_temp with stock config; re-run PID_CALIBRATE
